description: Exceptions to scripts/check-duplicate-editions.js: pairs of event ids whose Editions overlap >=80% in (name, total time) but are legitimately separate races (e.g. same venue listed under two series). Each entry is { "a": event id, "b": event id, "note": why they are distinct }. Add an entry only after manually confirming the Editions are NOT duplicates. The list is empty: the 13 pairs allowlisted in 5.0.2 were all resolved, 7 by consolidating duplicate events (commit 2cd160ae) and the last 6 by fixing mis-assigned TSVs and gender-split Events in 5.2.0 (commit 96cbaf88).
